message.content: According to the timeline provided, Li Hua informed Adam Smith that the rent for last month (May) had been transferred on June 1st at 16:00. In the conversation captured in source ID 2, Li Hua mentions, "Oh no, I completely forgot about that. I'll make sure to get that sorted out ASAP. Thanks for letting me know!" This indicates that the rent for May was still outstanding at that point, prompting Li Hua to address the matter promptly.
